bear_case: The BUY regime's July 6 execution depends on two independent events both resolving positively within hours of each other: (1) IBIT Gate 3 confirmation at ~10:00 AM ET — if IBIT reports a day 11+ outflow, BTC re-entry is blocked while BTC may continue toward $65,000 without the framework's institutional anchor, stranding the framework in cash at an increasingly expensive catch-up cost; (2) NVDA July 6 close above $195 — the evening fade from $200.06 to $194.83 in OTC trading (where sellers absorbed an entire Gate 3 move in a single session) suggests that when 10x the OTC liquidity arrives at the official July 6 open, the $200 distribution dynamics may be even more aggressive. A NVDA July 6 close below $195 triggers Stop Day 2, forcing a mandatory exit July 7 open at the same time as SPCX's $4.3B inclusion spike creates chaotic cross-name flow dynamics. Third risk: the SK Hynix price data inconsistency (prior brief ₩2,552,000 vs web data ₩2,425,000) is an unresolved question that could mean Stop Day 1 was already triggered July 3 — if so, the position is in Stop Day 2 status and the July 6 close is a mandatory determination event that cannot be ignored.
